faq.q: Do I need a security plugin?
faq.a: A reputable one adds value on WordPress, but it is not a substitute for updates and backups. Plugins cannot protect an unpatched site.

faq.q: Is my site too small to be a target?
faq.a: No, because you are not being chosen. Automated scanners test millions of sites for known vulnerabilities without caring who owns them.
Generally yes for the platform layer - Shopify, Framer and similar patch their own infrastructure. Your accounts and passwords are still your responsibility.
